purpose: Outcome-blind data-plane supplementation only. This policy does not authorize strategy retuning or performance recomputation.

yahoo_chart_api_native.notes: Existing native vendor path. No new Yahoo HTML scraping is authorized.

stooq_intraday_candidate.notes: Candidate only until exact acquisition method, raw-byte receipt, overlap agreement, timestamp semantics, adjustment policy, and XTKS session mapping are verified.

alpha_vantage_free.notes: Low-priority fallback. Free quota is conserved for unresolved symbols. Free daily endpoint may repair exact daily gaps only; it must not synthesize intraday/4H bars.

alpha_vantage_intraday_premium.notes: Disabled by default because current research assumes no premium entitlement. May become eligible only after explicit entitlement and provenance verification.

googlefinance_snapshot.notes: Approximate corroboration/future collection only. Delayed quote snapshots are never treated as authoritative historical intraday OHLCV.
